snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer Patch 1.2.0 The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back
snippet.description:
After the patch 1.2.0 the new cover hand drawn is up! I've also taken the time to add sound effects to my initial trailer, as it's better overall to follow. I'll tag this trailer everywhere related to my game so that it becomes the new "standard/default" trailer.

🦆Play 'The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back' on Steam on June 17th 2025: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413520/The_Duck_Amikaze_Strikes_Back/

Help Amikaze get his revenge! Run, jump, dodge, bounce and make your way as fast as you can to blast the local hunters! Revenge your family who ended up as tenders! And beat the gold times to become THE legendary duck!

You can also try my second game's demo if you want: 👵play Gran Theft Lure Demo on Steam right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/39...

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ FOLLOW ME HERE AND THERE ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
